meta.description: Test vectors for hybrid signature scheme (Ed448 + ML-DSA-65)

notes.signing_description: BoP-2 hybrid signature (Janneck 2025/1844 Fig. 6): the 57-byte Ed448 Schnorr response rsp is followed by the ML-DSA-65 signature sigma2 (3,309 bytes)
notes.public_key_format: Ed448 public key (57 bytes) || ML-DSA-65 public key (1,952 bytes)
notes.signature_format: Ed448 BoP-2 response rsp (57 bytes) || ML-DSA-65 signature sigma2 (3,309 bytes)
notes.verification: BoP-2: chl = H2(sigma2); R = ExtCom(rsp, chl); m' = H1(pkID || pkSig || message || R); accept iff ML-DSA-65 verifies sigma2 over m'. rsp is UR-guarded on decode.
notes.context_strings: Optional context strings use Ed448 and ML-DSA-65 native context mechanisms
notes.combiner: Bird-of-Prey-2 SUF-preserving combiner; replaces the pre-BoP-2 parallel concatenation of a standalone 114-byte Ed448 signature and sigma2.

context_support.description: Both Ed448 and ML-DSA-65 support context strings for domain separation
context_support.context_usage: sign_with_context(message, context) and verify_with_context(message, context, signature)

kat_notes.description: Byte-exact BoP-2 hybrid signature KATs. Reproduced from a 32-byte keypair seed (generate_from_seed) and a 32-byte BoP nonce seed (Ed448 bop_commit_deterministic, the vector-only commit hook). sigma2 (the ML-DSA-65 half) is a randomized signature pinned as bytes; the 57-byte Ed448 Schnorr response rsp reproduces byte-for-byte via chl = H2(sigma2) and respond(). The full stored signature verifies under the derived public key.
kat_notes.reproduction: keypair = generate_from_seed(keypair_seed); (R, nonce) = bop_commit_deterministic(nonce_seed); chl = H2(signature[57:]); rsp' = nonce.respond(chl); assert rsp' == signature[:57]; assert verify(public_key, message, signature).

kat_vectors.name: bop2_kat_fixed_message
kat_vectors.description: BoP-2 hybrid signature over a fixed message, reproduced from a deterministic keypair seed and BoP commit nonce seed. sigma2 is a (randomized) ML-DSA-65 signature pinned as-is; the 57-byte Schnorr response reproduces byte-for-byte from the commit hook.

kat_vectors.name: bop2_kat_empty_message
kat_vectors.description: BoP-2 hybrid signature over the empty message (edge case) with distinct deterministic seeds.

kat_context_notes.description: Byte-exact context-mode BoP-2 hybrid signature KATs (WR-03). Reproduced exactly like the plain kat_vectors, but m' is derived under SIG_BOP2_H1_CTX_CONTEXT (trelis-hybrid-sig-bop2-h1-ctx-v1) instead of SIG_BOP2_H1_CONTEXT, and the signed region is the length-prefixed context region ctx_len(1) || context_hex || message. The 57-byte Ed448 Schnorr response rsp reproduces byte-for-byte via chl = H2(sigma2) and respond() (rsp does not depend on m'); sigma2 (the ML-DSA-65 half) is a randomized signature pinned as bytes. Non-collision is baked in: the stored signature verifies under verify_with_context(message, context) but MUST fail plain verify() over the framed region ctx_len || context || message (they now derive m' under distinct H1 contexts).
kat_context_notes.reproduction: keypair = generate_from_seed(keypair_seed); (R, nonce) = bop_commit_deterministic(nonce_seed); region = ctx_len(1) || context_hex || message; chl = H2(signature[57:]); rsp' = nonce.respond(chl); assert rsp' == signature[:57]; assert verify_with_context(message, context_hex, signature) && !verify(region, signature).

kat_prehash_notes.description: Byte-exact prehash-mode BoP-2 hybrid signature KATs (WR-03). Reproduced exactly like the plain kat_vectors, but m' is derived under SIG_BOP2_H1_PREHASH_CONTEXT (trelis-hybrid-sig-bop2-h1-prehash-v1), and the signed region is the 32-byte BLAKE3 digest derive_key(context_string, message). rsp reproduces byte-for-byte (independent of m'); sigma2 is the randomized ML-DSA-65 half pinned as bytes. Non-collision is baked in: the stored signature verifies under verify_prehashed(context_string, message) but MUST fail plain verify() over the digest derive_key(context_string, message).
kat_prehash_notes.reproduction: keypair = generate_from_seed(keypair_seed); (R, nonce) = bop_commit_deterministic(nonce_seed); digest = derive_key(context_string, message); chl = H2(signature[57:]); rsp' = nonce.respond(chl); assert rsp' == signature[:57]; assert verify_prehashed(context_string, message, signature) && !verify(digest, signature).

kat_context_vectors.name: bop2_ctx_kat_fixed_message
kat_context_vectors.description: Context-mode BoP-2 hybrid signature (WR-03) over a fixed message and context, reproduced from deterministic keypair and BoP commit nonce seeds (distinct from every other KAT seed). m' derived under SIG_BOP2_H1_CTX_CONTEXT over ctx_len || context_hex || message. Verifies under verify_with_context and MUST fail plain verify over the framed region.

kat_prehash_vectors.name: bop2_prehash_kat_fixed_message
kat_prehash_vectors.description: Prehash-mode BoP-2 hybrid signature (WR-03) over a fixed message under a real registered prehash context string, reproduced from deterministic keypair and BoP commit nonce seeds (distinct from every other KAT seed). m' derived under SIG_BOP2_H1_PREHASH_CONTEXT over digest = derive_key(context_string, message). Verifies under verify_prehashed and MUST fail plain verify over the digest.
